reasoning: Shows a calendar page with a checkmark at the bottom-right corner, universally read as confirming a date, booking an appointment, or RSVPing. It fits tasks whose subject is scheduling, locking in dates, or confirming reservations—never tasks that simply happen to have a deadline. It can be confused with a plain calendar or a checklist clipboard at a glance.
